temporal_risks.risk: Planned MRT stations are labeled open
temporal_risks.evidence: The source marks all JRL nodes open. The operational proxy changes nearest MRT for 23,077 training and 7,948 test rows. LTA lists JRL openings in 2028–2029.
temporal_risks.assumption_needed: Invalid as an open-station measure; at most this can represent future planned accessibility.
temporal_risks.recommended_test: Correct status and add station opening dates, then rebuild features as-of each rental month.

temporal_risks.risk: 2026 station ridership used for earlier rentals
temporal_risks.evidence: Passenger volumes are averages from May–July 2026; training dates end in 2025-03.
temporal_risks.assumption_needed: 2026 ridership ranks are a stable station-busyness proxy available at prediction time.
temporal_risks.recommended_test: Time-based ablation with and without ridership features; describe them as static proxies.

temporal_risks.risk: Current mall and school snapshots applied historically
temporal_risks.evidence: Current source coordinates and attributes are applied uniformly across all rental months.
temporal_risks.assumption_needed: Facility presence and attributes were stable over the modeled period.
temporal_risks.recommended_test: Add opening/closure dates where available or run group ablations.

temporal_risks.evidence: One census snapshot is joined to every rental month.
temporal_risks.assumption_needed: Neighbourhood structure is sufficiently stable from 2021 onward.
temporal_risks.recommended_test: Use as location descriptors; do not interpret as month-specific demographics.

temporal_risks.evidence: Strictly earlier months are used, but materialized later holdout rows may include labels from earlier holdout months.
temporal_risks.assumption_needed: Predictions are refreshed monthly after prior-month rents become observable.
temporal_risks.recommended_test: For a fixed 6/12-month forecast, rebuild all validation features using only labels available at the fold cutoff.

temporal_risks.risk: Mall aggregate sums conflate no known detail with zero known total
temporal_risks.evidence: np.nansum returns zero when no qualifying mall has a known attribute.
temporal_risks.assumption_needed: Zero is interpreted as known-value sum, not actual total mall capacity.
temporal_risks.recommended_test: Add counts of malls with known floor-area/store values within 2 km.
